title: Campus Connect
description: Developed a peer collaboration web platform using React for the front-end and Node.js for the backend logic. Implemented group-based interaction and information sharing features among students. Focused on component-based UI design, API integration, and clean code structure.

title: Bus Reservation System
description: Built a console-based bus reservation system using object-oriented design principles. Implemented ticket booking, cancellation, seat availability, and user management functionalities.

title: Brick Breaker Game
description: Developed a classic Brick Breaker game implementing game loop, collision detection, and scoring logic. Applied object-oriented principles with classes for ball, paddle, bricks, and game state management. Handled real-time user input and game state transitions effectively.
